fusions.name: Sticky Snatch
fusions.desc: A lash that sticks and deals 12 damage, [Stuns] the target for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bog-Spray Crack
fusions.desc: A spraying crack deals 8 damage to every enemy in a cone 5 tiles ahead. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Spring Off the Coil
fusions.desc: Springs you 4 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
